tr.en: I've lost my sense of smell.
Dogs have a strong sense of smell.

tr.de: Hunde haben eine sehr gute Nase.

tr.en: The dog has a very keen sense of smell.

нюх.text: У того репортёра нюх на новости.

tr.en: That reporter has a nose for news.
The girl is smelling the flowers.
tr.de: Das Mädchen riecht an den Blumen.

tr.en: The dog was sniffing a stick.

нюхать.text: Почему людям нравится нюхать свои пуки?

tr.en: Why do people like to smell their own farts?
tr.uk: Чому людям подобається нюхати власні гази?

tr.en: Don't sniff glue. It's bad for you.
